head.title: Kymia — AI-powered medical clinical simulation
head.description: Learn medical semiology through interactive consultations with virtual patients. Diagnosis, exams, clinical reasoning.

hero.badge: Generative AI · unlimited cases · fully in French
hero.description: Kymia is a university clinical simulator. You lead the interview, examine the patient, order tests, make your diagnosis — the AI plays the patient and the senior examiner.

realPatients.title: Realistic virtual patients
realPatients.desc: Every case is unique. The patient responds just like in real life: imprecise, sometimes forgetful.

reasoning.title: Clinical reasoning
reasoning.desc: Physical exams, labs, imaging: order freely. Results stay consistent with the underlying condition.

feedback.title: Educational feedback
feedback.desc: A detailed report after each case: score, missed exams, pathophysiology, personalized advice.

leaderboard.title: Global leaderboard
leaderboard.desc: Compare your performance with other learners and progress specialty by specialty.

privacy.title: Your data stays private
privacy.desc: Your consultations are saved so you can resume any time, exactly where you left off.

specialties.title: 6 specialties
specialties.desc: Internal medicine, surgery, pediatrics, obstetrics & gynecology, psychiatry, emergency medicine.

footer: © {year} Kymia · Educational simulation. No real medical value.
